Hello,

I'm applying for your Graduate Engineering Program in civil engineering, after reading the Graduate Program section of your careers page, which asks graduates to email HR.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and then field engineer, reviewing drawings and doing site inspections and quality checks.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My preferred office is Central Victoria, and I'm open to discussing a move to your Queensland or Northern NSW offices.

Your program's mentoring by senior engineers toward professional accreditation is what I'm looking for, since I don't yet have Australian consulting employment.

Could we talk about a graduate civil place? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
